cases.name: digest-vectors
cases.notes: §11.5 canonical JSON and the digest, pinned byte for byte: key order by UTF-8 bytes (`z` before `é`), no whitespace, `null` kept; numbers — integral below 2^53 without a fraction (`1.0` → `1`, `-0` → `0`), others by ECMAScript Number::toString (`1.5`, `0.30000000000000004`, `1e+21`, `1e-7`, `9007199254740992`, `1.7976931348623157e+308`, `123456789012345680000`); strings — only `"`, `\\` and U+0000–U+001F escaped (`\b \f \n \r \t`, else `\u00xx` lower-case), `/` and non-ASCII literal; the last vector is an empty plan core — its `digest` is the `plan_id` a planner must give it (`execute-plan-edited-is-plan-mismatch` reports the same value as `actual`).
